meta.title: Modular Training Tower
meta.description: TZJ MOD series modular fire training buildings feature hot-dip galvanized steel frames, open layouts, and stackable expansion—outlasting container conversion alternatives.

hero.title: Modular Fire Training Buildings
hero.description: A modular training system built by firefighters for firefighters. Stackable, configurable, and expandable—maximum flexibility and value for your training program.

overview.title: More than container conversion
overview.description: Many choose containers for perceived cost savings. The MOD series is purpose-built for fire training—structural integrity from a fully galvanized steel frame with open floor plans and no interior load-bearing walls.
overview.lead: Walls are independent of structure; doors and windows can be reconfigured freely. Service life exceeds stacked containers by more than double.
overview.body: Composite floors with slope and drainage design avoid the rot and corrosion common in stacked containers. An economical, grant-eligible solution that expands easily over time.

seriesSection.title: Standard 8′ × 20′ × 8′6″ modules, freely combined
seriesSection.description: Modules stack, position, and align in countless configurations to meet your training needs. Every building aligns with NFPA 1400/1402 and comparable live-fire training standards.

series.name: M Series
series.desc: Entry-level simulator for basic live-fire training; 2-story main tower plus single-story annex.

series.name: O Series
series.desc: Open floor plan for office/warehouse scenarios; 2-story residential/industrial units plus annex.

series.name: D Series
series.desc: Large open-span floor plan; 2-story residential/industrial units.

series.name: X Series
series.desc: 4-story main tower plus 2-story residential/industrial units and single-story annex.

compareSection.title: Better construction, longer life, greater flexibility
compareSection.description: Yes, containers can be adapted—but should firefighters face additional toxin exposure on top of an already high-risk profession?

compareRows.label: Structure protection
compareRows.modx: Hot-dip galvanized steel; no recoating required
compareRows.container: Rust begins at delivery; compromises structural capacity

compareRows.label: Layout & stacking
compareRows.modx: Custom module sizes; stack up to 5 stories
compareRows.container: Unrealistic layout—corridors too wide, rooms too small

compareRows.label: Materials & process
compareRows.modx: Purpose-built with new materials; no welded assembly
compareRows.container: Fumigation treatment; toxic coatings; hard to meet standards

compareRows.label: Drainage
compareRows.container: No interior drainage design; standing water

customSection.title: Modular construction proven over decades
customSection.description: Built from new materials with more than double the lifespan of stacked containers. Galvanized steel frame supports open plans; walls, doors, and windows move, remove, or reconfigure.
customSection.lead: Composite floors with slope, drainage, and engineering details avoid rot and corrosion common in stacked containers.
customSection.body: High performance and quality departments already expect—delivered as an economical, grant-eligible solution with room to expand.
